name: Mahatma (Exalted)
body:
The Mahatma (“great soul”) class is the final goal for pacifist divine characters. Religious teachers and mystics, mahatmas are living examples of nonviolence.

Requirements

To become a mahatma, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Alignment: Any good.
Deity: Must worship a good deity granting the Community domain.
Feats: Either Celestial Obedience or Deific Obedience; Peacemaker; either Virtuous Creed (Mercy) or Virtuous Creed (Peace)
Skills: Diplomacy 5 ranks.

This alters requirements.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A mahatma who wears any armor of shield is unable to cast spells or use any of her supernatural or spell-like class abilities while doing so and for 24 hours thereafter.

This alters weapon and armor proficiencies.

Pacifying Touch (Su)

Starting at 2nd level, a mahatma can pacify hostile or angry creatures. The effect is as if the mahatma had cast calm emotions on the target creature, with a caster level equal to her mahatma level. The mahatma can affect only a single target with each use of the ability, and must succeed at a touch attack to do so. A touched creature can attempt a saving throw (DC = 10 + ½ the mahatma’s level + her Charisma bonus) to resist the effect. Pacifying touch can only dispel spells that incite negative or violent emotions in the target, such as fear or rage. A mahatma can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Wisdom or Charisma modifier (her choice).

This replaces vitality.

Censure Evil (Su)

At 4th level, the mahatma can panic evil outsiders as if using the Turn Undead feat against undead.

The mahatma can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Charisma modifier, at a cleric level equal to her mahatma level.

This replaces religious speaker.
